meta.name: muapi-amazon-product-listing
meta.description: Generate a complete Amazon product listing image set — hero image, lifestyle shot, infographic with features, and comparison/detail closeups optimized for Amazon standards.

copy.tagline: 生成符合亚马逊标准的主图、场景图、卖点图与对比图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在亚马逊上卖货，需要专业的产品图片来提升点击和转化。
copy.tagline_en: Generate Amazon-compliant hero, lifestyle, infographic, and comparison images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you sell on Amazon and need professional product images to improve clicks and conversions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的产品信息，自动生成一套四张亚马逊商品图：主图、场景图、功能信息图、细节特写图。
howto.when: 当你提到“亚马逊商品图”、“产品摄影”等关键词，或要求为商品制作亚马逊图片时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成这款不锈钢水瓶的亚马逊商品图。
say.note: Claude 会询问产品名称、类别、核心功能等信息。

say.text: 为我的运动水壶做一套亚马逊图片，包括主图和场景图。
say.note: Claude 会生成四张图并展示。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can generate a complete set of four Amazon product listing images based on your product info: hero image, lifestyle shot, feature infographic, and closeup detail shot.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "amazon listing", "product photography", or ask to create Amazon product images.

say_en.text: Generate Amazon listing images for this stainless steel water bottle.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for product name, category, key features, etc.

say_en.text: Create a set of Amazon images for my sports bottle, including hero and lifestyle shots.
say_en.note: Claude will generate all four images and display them.
